author: fenix247
quote: Easy 10/10. Growing up with the original I was worried they might change too much, but they nailed it. The 60 fps makes combat and exploring feel effortless, switching items doesnt stop the flow anymore, and the soundtrack gave me chills all over again. Worth every single penny, and honestly im hoping they drop some DLC for this and give Majora's Mask the same remake treatment next.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: fenix247
quote: Easily the worst way to play at launch. While Xbox Series X players used the New Zealand trick to jump in 18 hours early and get Quick Resume plus system-level VRR smoothing, PS5 owners got stuck behind strict region locks with none of those perks. Beneath that, you're still dealing with a choppy 30 FPS cap that dips into the 20s, heavy controls, and tedious, on-rails missions.

author: fenix247
quote: Not gonna lie the graphics and the world are insane, easily the best looking open world out right now. The problem is the actual game is boring to play. Controls are heavy, 30 fps dips a lot in big fights, and missions are way too restrictive. Feels like they cared more about realism than making it fun.
